text: I learned forestry work from my uncle.
He died after a landslide during a logging operation.
We never fully agreed on where safe boundaries were.
The forest edge is not fixed.
It shifts slightly every few years.
Most villagers do not notice this.
Some trees near old paths are older than surrounding forest.
They are unusually dense and difficult to cut.
I avoid those areas when possible.
Fen sometimes enters deeper forest zones alone.
I worry he is too confident.
Kiri once followed him partway into restricted areas.
She returned safely, but did not describe everything clearly.
Doran once reported stonework appearing beneath soil near irrigation edges close to forest zones.
I have seen similar formations near logging paths.
They are not part of any known construction system.
After the Night of Ash, forest behavior changed for several seasons.
Animals avoided certain sections entirely.
Even logging routes became less predictable.
Eventually things returned to 'normal.'
But not exactly.
Some routes never fully recovered.
I do not report every anomaly immediately.
Some patterns need time before they can be trusted.
The small ancient building near the monument feels connected to forest disturbances.
I have no proof.
But I have noticed correlations over time.
The deeper forest becomes quieter near certain directions.
Not emptier.
That difference matters.
